prompt:
Reconstruct the central object of the given 2D image as a true 3D wireframe model.

- Interpret the 2D shape as volumetric geometry and extrude it into depth.

- Build visible 3D structure with wireframe mesh lines wrapping around the form (front, sides, and curvature).

- Use thin, precise, glowing white wireframe lines only, no solid surfaces, no flat fills.

- Apple App Store style icon, premium iOS design language, WWDC-inspired.

- Rounded square app icon, centered and symmetrical.

- Soft blue gradient background, subtle glow.

- Clean orthographic front view with clear depth cues (z-axis wireframe).

- High-resolution, futuristic UI icon.

- No text, no logos, no illustration style


Negatives:

2D flat design, flat icon, illustration, lighting-only depth, fake 3D, gradients on object, shading, shadows, cartoon style, sketch, photorealism, textures, noise, grain
improvedPrompt:
Improved prompt:

Reconstruct the central object of the given 2D image as a high-fidelity 3D wireframe model.

- Interpret the 2D shape as volumetric geometry and extrude it into depth, maintaining the original proportions and symmetry of the design.

- Build a visible 3D wireframe mesh consisting of thin, precise, glowing white lines wrapping around the form, clearly defining the front, sides, and curvature of the object.

- Use only wireframe mesh lines, no solid surfaces, no flat fills, and no shading or shadows that imply depth. Maintain a consistent line width and spacing across the entire model.

- Design the wireframe in the style of a premium Apple iOS app icon, adhering to the Apple App Store guidelines and the design language showcased at WWDC events. Use a rounded square icon shape that is symmetrical and centered.

- Include a subtle blue gradient background that functions as a depth cue, with the lightest color at the top and the darkest at the bottom. Apply a soft, even glow around the edge of the icon.

- Render the wireframe model in a clean orthographic front view with clear depth cues along the z-axis, ensuring the wireframe lines appear to recede into the background. Maintain a high resolution that is suitable for a modern iOS device.

- Exclude any text, logos, or illustration styles in the final output. The wireframe lines should be the only visible elements in the image.

- Negatives to avoid: 2D flat design, 2D flat icon, illustration styles, lighting-only depth cues, fake 3D effects, gradients applied directly to the object, shading, shadows, cartoon or sketch styles, photorealism, textures, noise, or grain.

Please provide the 3D wireframe model reconstruction in a high-resolution format suitable for iOS app icon use, adhering to the specified design constraints and style guidelines.
